topics.title: Depot Sizing, Power Grid Feasibility & Substation Capacity
topics.objective: Evaluate utility substation power availability and size MW depot connections for commercial fleets.
topics.example: TotalDemand = (Number of Buses * Charger kW) * DiversityFactor
topics.exercise: Calculate peak grid connection requirements for an urban delivery hub charging 80 electric vans simultaneously.

topics.title: Smart Charging Optimization & Time-of-Use (TOU) Rates
topics.objective: Schedule charging cycles during overnight off-peak electricity tariffs to minimize operating costs.
topics.example: ChargeSchedule: Prioritize low-demand windows (00:00 - 05:00) with dynamic load throttling.
topics.exercise: Build an optimization algorithm shifting charging demand to minimize peak demand utility surcharges.

topics.title: OCPP 2.0.1 Protocol & Charger Management Systems
topics.objective: Standardize charger telemetry, remote start/stop, and firmware management via Open Charge Point Protocol.
topics.example: OCPP message: BootNotification, Heartbeat, StatusNotification, MeterValues
topics.exercise: Implement an OCPP WebSocket handler receiving real-time charging status and kilowatt-hour consumption.

topics.title: Battery State of Health (SOH) & Degradation Modeling
topics.objective: Mitigate lithium battery degradation through automated charging rate limits and thermal management.
topics.exercise: Create an automated policy throttling DC fast charging whenever battery core temperature exceeds 42°C.

topics.title: Fleet Charging as a Service (CaaS) Subscription Models
topics.objective: Structure commercial multi-tenant subscription tiers, per-mile billing, and SLA uptime guarantees.
topics.example: MonthlyFee = (Fixed Base / Vehicle) + (kWh Consumed * Tariff Rate) + Uptime Guarantee
topics.exercise: Formulate a 3-year commercial subscription model with 99.5% charger availability SLAs for logistics operators.
